project.name: MapOSMatic seamap overlay
project.description: Mapnik overlay style rendering sea marks and lights similar to OpenSeaMap, for printable maps with MapOSMatic.

tags.description: Any node with seamark:light:* tags gets a light flare in the light's colour (also numbered seamark:light:N:* sector tags)
